description.value:
As an Action, you can magically emit a powerful field of gravitational energy that tugs at other creatures for up to 1 minute or until your Concentration ends (as if you were concentrating on a spell). For the duration, whenever a creature hostile to you starts its turn within 60 feet of you, it must make a Strength Saving Throw against your spell save DC. On a failed save, it takes 4d10 + Intelligence modifier force damage, and its Speed is reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage, and every foot it moves this turn costs 2 extra feet of movement.

Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest or until you expend a spell slot of 5th level or higher to use this feature again.
